description: Produce a comprehensive security audit report documenting all findings with severity levels, file locations, and explanations. The report should be written to .agents/tasks/task-security-audit/SECURITY-AUDIT-REPORT.md
steps: Create the security audit report at .agents/tasks/task-security-audit/SECURITY-AUDIT-REPORT.md documenting all vulnerabilities found during code review
acceptance_criteria: Report is comprehensive and covers all source files
Each finding has severity, location, description, and impact
Findings are genuinely hidden/subtle issues not already documented in SECURITY-MODEL.md as out-of-scope
verification: Report file exists and is well-structured
findings: 20 findings documented across side-channel, memory safety, input validation, protocol, and correctness categories. No Critical findings. 5 Medium, 10 Low, 5 Informational.
